name: Grelin Whitebeard's Journal
summary: Grelin Whitebeard records Frostmane troll activity in a field journal in Coldridge Valley. Grik'nir the Cold steals the journal and carries it into the troll cave.

sections.title: A Scout's Ledger
sections.body: Grelin Whitebeard watches the Frostmane trolls near Coldridge Valley and writes down what they do. His leatherbound notebook records their strength, their organization, and the danger they pose. Grik'nir the Cold takes the journal during a confrontation or ambush. The marked troll brute carries it into the troll cave, leaving Grelin without the notes he needs to finish his report. So he asks passing adventurers to retrieve the book.

sections.title: Dispatch to Senir
sections.body: Grelin Whitebeard studies the recovered notes and judges the Frostmane threat in Coldridge Valley temporarily contained. With his jottings, he finishes a dispatch about the Frostmane uprising. Couriers carry the sealed message to his brother, Senir Whitebeard, who is stationed elsewhere in Dun Morogh.

faq.answer: Grik'nir the Cold stole Grelin Whitebeard's journal. The heavily marked Frostmane troll brute took it into the troll cave in Coldridge Valley.

faq.q: What is written in the journal?
faq.answer: Grelin Whitebeard's journal holds field notes on the local Frostmane trolls, the threat they pose, and the safety of Coldridge Valley.

faq.q: What happens after the journal is recovered?
aliases: what does grelin do with the journal
faq.answer: Grelin uses the recovered notes to finish a report on the trolls. He asks an adventurer to carry it to his brother, Senir Whitebeard.

faq.q: Why is this journal so important to Grelin?
aliases: why does grelin want it back
faq.answer: Grelin needs his journal to prepare an accurate report on the Frostmane uprising for the dwarven authorities and his brother Senir. Without it, the state of Coldridge Valley's defenses is uncertain.

angles.text: As a dwarf, recovering Grelin's journal preserves vital knowledge of the Frostmane threat near Ironforge's training grounds.
